# Upload-Post

Upload-Post publishes, schedules, and manages content across social networks through one API.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/upload-post/.

## Actions

- **Cancel Scheduled Post**: Permanently cancel a scheduled post before publication and delete its staged assets.
- **Create Profile**: Create an Upload-Post profile for a unique caller-owned username.
- **Enqueue Post**: Insert one video, photo carousel, or text post into a profile's external publication queue.
- **Get Upload Status** (read-only): Get the processing status and per-platform results for an asynchronous or scheduled upload.
- **List Cached Post Analytics** (read-only): Return one page of cached per-post analytics for a profile without consuming the live platform-analytics request limit.
- **List Platform Destinations** (read-only): List selectable Facebook Pages, LinkedIn organizations, Pinterest boards, or Google Business locations for an already connected profile.
- **List Profiles** (read-only): List Upload-Post profiles and their connected social accounts.
- **List Scheduled Posts** (read-only): Return one page of pending scheduled posts and the job IDs needed to edit or cancel them.
- **List Upload History** (read-only): Return one page of past and in-progress Upload-Post uploads, including platform post IDs, URLs, request IDs, and failures.
- **Publish Post**: Immediately publish one video, photo carousel, or text post to external connected platforms.
- **Schedule Post**: Schedule one video, photo carousel, or text post for future external publication to connected platforms.
- **Update Scheduled Post**: Change the future publication time, title, or caption of an existing scheduled post.
